/terms-and-conditions.title: Terms & Conditions
/terms-and-conditions.description: Information about shopping, product availability and orders at Rainz Lifestyle.
sections: Shopping with Rainz Lifestyle

These terms govern purchases from Rainz Lifestyle. Before placing an order, read these Terms & Conditions, our Privacy Policy, and our Return & Refund Policy. Checkout requires your explicit agreement to all three policies.
Products, prices and availability

Prices are displayed in Bangladeshi Taka (BDT). Available quantities and size options are shown on product pages. Out-of-stock products cannot be ordered. Product colours may vary slightly between screens. Delivery charges and any applicable discounts are displayed at checkout before you place your order.
Orders and payment

Provide accurate customer and delivery details. We accept cash on delivery and online payment through SSLCommerz using the methods available on its payment page. An online order is paid only after the payment gateway confirms the transaction. Contact us with your order number if a payment is deducted but not confirmed; do not place a duplicate order. Order fulfillment status is separate from payment status.
Delivery

Delivery is within 5 days inside Dhaka and within 10 days outside Dhaka, counted from order confirmation. We will contact you if a delivery delay occurs. See our Delivery Policy for the delivery process.
Cancellation, returns and refunds

Contact customer support with your order number as soon as possible to request cancellation. Before dispatch, we will confirm whether cancellation is possible. For dispatched or delivered orders, follow our Return & Refund Policy. Approved refunds are processed within 7 to 10 working days after refund approval and, where a return is required, receipt and inspection of the returned item.
Third-party advertisements and services

Rainz Lifestyle does not display third-party advertisements. If third-party advertisements are introduced, Rainz Lifestyle will take responsibility for the advertisements it permits. Rainz Lifestyle remains responsible for customer information it shares with third parties in providing its services, as described in the Privacy Policy.
Customer support
For product, payment, delivery or policy questions, contact us using the email or phone number below. Include your order number where applicable.

/privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy
/privacy-policy.description: How information is used when you browse, create an account or place an order with Rainz Lifestyle.
sections: Information we collect

We process information you provide when browsing, creating an account, contacting support or placing an order, including your name, email, phone number, delivery address and order details. Payment transaction references and confirmation status are used to reconcile payments.
How we use and share information

We use customer information to manage accounts, process orders and payments, arrange delivery, prevent misuse and respond to support requests. Necessary details may be shared with SSLCommerz, delivery partners and hosting or service providers for those purposes. Rainz Lifestyle is responsible for the customer information it shares with these third parties and limits sharing to what is needed to provide the service. We do not sell customer information for third-party advertising.
Payment security

Online payment takes place on the SSLCommerz hosted payment page. Rainz Lifestyle does not collect or store your card number, CVV, banking password or payment OTP in its checkout. We retain transaction references and payment status for order verification and support. Never disclose your password, PIN, CVV or OTP to our support team.
Cookies and browser storage

The website uses browser storage for sign-in sessions, cart and wishlist features, guest order references and payment-return information. Essential cookies or similar technologies may also be used by our payment provider on its own payment page. You can clear or block cookies and site storage using your browser settings, but doing so may affect sign-in and shopping features.
Retention and access

We retain information as needed to fulfill orders, handle returns and payment disputes, and meet applicable record-keeping obligations. Access is limited to people and service providers who need it for these purposes.
Your choices and external links

Contact us to request access to, correction of or deletion of your information. Some records may need to be retained to complete an order or meet record-keeping obligations. Social and messaging links open external services whose privacy policies apply there.

/cancellation-return-policy.title: Return & Refund Policy
/cancellation-return-policy.description: How to request a cancellation, return, exchange or refund from Rainz Lifestyle.
sections: Cancellation

Contact us as soon as possible with your order number to request a cancellation or change. We will check whether the order has been dispatched and confirm the available options. A paid cancellation that we approve will be refunded under the timeline below.
Requesting a return

Contact us promptly after delivery with your order number, the item name, the reason for the return and photographs if the item is incorrect, damaged or defective. Our team will review your request and provide return instructions and the return address. Please contact us before shipping an item back.
Condition of returned items

For a size or change-of-mind return request, keep the item unused and unwashed, with original tags, packaging and proof of purchase. For damaged, defective or incorrect items, keep the item and packaging for review; the unused-condition requirement does not prevent reporting a defect discovered when checking the item.
Return process and delivery costs

After reviewing your request, we will confirm eligibility, collection or shipping arrangements, and any return delivery costs before you send the item. Rainz Lifestyle covers return delivery costs for a confirmed incorrect or defective item. Once received, we inspect the item and notify you of the refund or exchange decision. Exchanges depend on stock availability.
Refund timeline: 7 to 10 working days

Approved refunds are processed within 7 to 10 working days after refund approval and, where a return is required, receipt and inspection of the returned item. Working days exclude weekends and public holidays. Online-payment refunds are returned through the original payment method. For cash-on-delivery purchases, customer support will agree a refund method with you. We will confirm the refundable amount, including any applicable delivery charge, when approving the refund.
Refund support

If your approved refund has not arrived after 10 working days, contact us with your order number and any refund reference. We will check its status with the payment provider and update you. Never send your PIN, password or OTP.

/faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
/faqs.description: Answers about Rainz Lifestyle's men's collection, sizes, checkout and order support.
sections: Which products can I shop now?
Our men's collection is currently available. Products in other categories will be added later.
How do I choose a size?
Check the sizes and any size chart on the product page. Contact us for guidance if you are unsure before ordering.
How do I place an order?
Open a product, choose the required options, add it to your bag and continue to checkout. Review your contact details, address and total before submitting.
What does delivery cost?
The delivery charge is shown at checkout for your selected delivery area. Delivery is within 5 days inside Dhaka and within 10 days outside Dhaka from order confirmation.
How can I track or change my order?
Use Track Order or contact support with your order number. For cancellation, returns and exchanges, read our Return & Refund Policy.

/delivery-policy.title: Delivery Policy
/delivery-policy.description: Delivery timelines and the order delivery process for Rainz Lifestyle in Bangladesh.
sections: Inside Dhaka
Delivery is within 5 days from order confirmation. The delivery charge is shown at checkout before you place your order.
Outside Dhaka
Delivery is within 10 days from order confirmation. The delivery charge is shown at checkout before you place your order.
Delivery process

We confirm your order and payment method, prepare available items, and hand the parcel to our delivery partner. Provide a complete address and an active phone number so the delivery partner can contact you. Use Track Order or contact our team with your order number for updates.
Delays and delivery problems

If an address is incomplete, an item becomes unavailable, or an unexpected disruption delays delivery, we will contact you with an update and explain the available options. Report a missing, damaged or incorrect parcel to customer support. Cancellation and refund requests are handled under our Return & Refund Policy.
